workload_work_year_days_001.answer: 184 workdays (A-1, A-2, A-3 matrices); 194 days (Audiologists and Physical Therapists with clinical doctorates)
workload_work_year_days_001.evidence: For employees on the A-1, A-2 and A-3 salary matrices, the work year shall consist of one hundred eighty-four (184) workdays. / Audiologists and Physical Therapists with clinical doctorates... working a one hundred and ninety four (194) day year

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: The parties have a mutual interest in ensuring that special education teachers receive sufficient preparation and planning time. / The District shall continue to schedule preparation time and lunch periods for teachers

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: Teachers shall not be required to send students to another teacher (who has a class of students) in to get their preparation period.
